name: make-app
description: Create desktop apps and installable web exports from local projects.

interface.shortDescription: Create a desktop or installable web app
interface.longDescription: Create native desktop apps for Windows, macOS or Linux using an existing project folder, or export a static web build for phones and browsers. Desktop outputs require their original folder; web exports require HTTPS hosting. Independent local preview.
defaultPrompt: Make a desktop app for this project.
Export this static build as an installable web app.
